You might meet: Bernie the Chameleon, Ginger the Bearded Dragon, Vince the Red-Footed Tortoise, or Cupcake the Rabbit. Surprises abound! Please arrive on time. Project HumaneKind teaches compassion and respect for living beings. Through humane education, they combat cruelty and indifference and bring awareness to the intelligent, social, and emotional depths of our fellow animals. Visit them online at www.projecthumanekind.org .
